Name: Zebrus Where is my Fish
Author: Zebruu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Search fish by name as you type. Results update instantly.

Filter by mod, location, season, weather, catch category (normal or legendary), and whether you've already caught it. Filters are combinable and automatically narrow each other - picking a mod only shows locations that mod actually adds fish to, for example.

Press the "My Location" button to instantly filter to wherever you're currently standing, in the current season and weather.

Open a fish's detail view to see every location and season it can be caught in, its weather requirement, time window, catch difficulty, source mod, and how many times you've caught it.

Fish data is read directly from the game's own Data/Fish and Data/Locations assets, so fish added by other mods (Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Stardew Valley Expanded, and others) are automatically included - no compatibility patch needed for most mods.

You'll receive a short letter from Robin the morning after you catch your first fish, mentioning the search hotkey.[/color]

[b][size=4]What is new in[/size][/b]

[center][b][size=4]1.1.0[/size][/b][/center]

[center][size=3]- Adds a "season only" option to the season filter (e.g. "Fall only" instead of just "Fall"), for fish that are exclusively available in one season. [/size][/center]

[b][size=4]Language[/size][/b]
English and German

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
- Zebrus Core[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Optional[/size][/b]
- Generic Mod Config Menu (to change the hotkey in-game)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Multiplayer/split-screen safe. Automatically detects fish from most Content Patcher-based mods without needing to be updated for them individually. Mod origin detection (shown as "From: ...") is based on common naming conventions and a small list of known mods, so it may occasionally show "Vanilla" or a mod's raw internal ID for less common mods - this doesn't affect search or filtering accuracy, only the displayed source label.[/color]
